//: Editor/LSP convenience config only. The authoritative build (npm run build) uses the seven per-concern project configs under src/ (tsc -b), which enforce the DOM-vs-node lib split and the rootDir->output mapping. This config combines all source into one program so editors resolve every src file and cross-concern browser globals (Module, defaultModules, translations) the way the runtime does; lib-mismatch and project-boundary errors are caught by the real build. The consumer-only ambient shims are excluded here because in the combined program their globals are already provided by their defining source files (declaring them again would be a duplicate-identifier error).
